concept.name: Corporate Carbon Disclosure Reconciliation Desk
concept.targetBuyer: ESG assurance analysts, sustainability reporting teams, and accounting reviewers
concept.buyerProblem: Public corporate energy and emissions disclosures are often embedded in filings with inconsistent layouts, units, factor years, and levels of detail, making it costly to determine which figures can be reproduced and which require human follow-up.
concept.centralClaim: A bounded reviewer-operated proof can extract declared company-level energy and emissions figures from a small, licensed set of public filings, preserve page-level provenance, normalize units, and reproduce only calculations supported by explicit activity and factor evidence while routing insufficient or contradictory disclosures to review.

authorizedScope: Planning and primary-source feasibility checks only. No filing acquisition, credential creation, proof implementation, delegated research/build work, hosting, paid services, publication, or claim of regulatory compliance is authorized. Earlier publication approvals do not transfer to WS-004.
nextAction: Human approval or rejection of Candidate A and the four-turn delegated-agent ceiling. Approval authorizes only a bounded vertical proof after the source contract and final evidence/VALIDATION_PLAN.json are frozen; expansion and publication remain separate approval gates.

humanApproval.basis: WS-004 was initialized after WS-003 release preservation. No WS-004 concept, proof, expansion, hosting, or publication approval has been granted.

repairableConditions: Before any source acquisition or implementation, verify the exact reuse/licensing terms applicable to the selected Companies House filing documents and record the permitted public-evidence treatment.

Before implementation, confirm that at least three bounded company filings expose sufficient SECR content in supported PDF or XHTML form to exercise the declared oracle without collecting personal fields.
Before implementation, finalize and freeze the project-local evidence/VALIDATION_PLAN.json with exact artifact paths and the final builder identity.
If a filing lacks explicit activity detail or usable units, route it to REVIEW_REQUIRED rather than inferring a conversion basis.

If filing reuse does not permit retained source documents or screenshots, use hashes, source metadata, reviewer-supplied files, and permitted narrow excerpts only; request approval if that makes the public evidence inadequate.
limitations: No client posting was supplied. Demand evidence is indirect and inherited from the recorded public-preliminary market matrix; it does not prove demand for this exact service.
The Companies House API requires an API key, and the official Document API is not available in its sandbox. No credential has been created or requested for WS-004.
The proof would assess reproducibility and evidence sufficiency, not certify emissions, legal compliance, audit assurance, or company truthfulness.
Only company-level metrics may be retained or displayed; personal names, signatures, contact details, and unrelated filing content are out of scope.

agentBudget.allocationPlan: The validator and one repair recheck are reserved before any research/build agent. No research or build delegation is planned; root will perform a bounded proof if approved. Any use beyond four turns or any second repair pass requires new human approval.
